public_gate_plan.compile: required strict static parser/lint evidence from the generated-deliverable gate
public_gate_plan.ast: required strict generated-deliverable structural evidence when candidate exists
public_gate_plan.toolchain: required ModelSim compile/run plus later physical TD evidence; simulation does not prove timing

interface.decision: no public port, width or instance-interface changes
interface.observation_semantics: o_pre_accept moves from direct round input to elastic-cut capture; its count remains one per scalar

requirements: active-low reset clears cut valid and payload
every actual age across cut+9+6+9 stages must be tested with task-local loop indices
after reset table_loaded and input_ready must be low until a complete reload
no pre-reset tag or value may appear after reload

timing_pipeline.root_path: v10 selection/product/shift/tag combinational cone directly enters pre round registers
timing_pipeline.repair: one registered cut of product/shift/tag before the unchanged pre round
timing_pipeline.expected_effect: one accepted advance cycle added, II=1 preserved by same-edge consume/refill

requirements: full stalled cut must hold product, shift and tag stable
full advancing cut may transfer old and capture new on the same edge
group mask clears only on cut capture, never merely on round advance
held table reload cannot block draining old work
register all 64 signed product bits without pre-round truncation
lane factors remain signed 32-bit 1,3,5 and shifts remain 0,2,4
cut is ordinary flops with clock enable behavior, not a new clock domain
no generated clock, latch, multicycle exception or constraint relaxation
physical rerun must identify startpoint/endpoint and setup/hold coverage

required: same four frozen DW/PW cases and all 640 accumulator/pre/SiLU/post/writeback values
continuous groups, fixed and seeded-random gaps, random output/commit ready
empty and tail-valid long backpressure with Q+R, pre, meta, post and scalar-obligation maxima
all actual pipeline reset ages with local task indices and explicit count assertion
partial table, held reload, terminal atomic fault and lane coefficient switching
fresh v9 MAC123, v9 serial four-layer, original 14/reset6, round7042 and SiLU65536 regressions

risks: a valid-only register without elastic ready creates loss under global pre-round stall
counting only the nine round stages can make table reload overwrite a live cut token
capturing tag or shift from the current head instead of the accepted scalar corrupts same-edge replacement
adding one scalar slot raises the structural safe upper bound from 30 to 31; the directed model observed 30 from empty and 22 with an existing tail, and RTL measurement remains required

the Python fatal-fault model discards masked old tokens, but frozen RTL subcores may retain internal bits until reset; only external suppression, stopped admission, and reset plus full reload are claimed
the model global-idle predicate includes runner reservation state; the standalone wrapper has no reservation port, so the composed runner IDLE/table gate must provide that fence
busy counters overlap and must not be summed into endpoint latency
functional PASS cannot claim the original physical setup violation is repaired
